project_type: React 18 + Vite 5 + TypeScript 5 multi-page SPA (frontend/) served by AWS Amplify Hosting; backend is separate AWS CDK stack (not touched by this task)
build_system: Vite multi-page build. Frontend is an independent npm project under frontend/ with its own package.json. Build = `tsc -b && vite build` (npm run build). Dev = `npm run dev`.
test_framework: Frontend currently has NO test tooling (no jest/vitest, no test deps). Backend (repo root) uses jest but is out of scope. Do NOT add a frontend test runner because that would require new dependencies which cannot be installed in this sandbox and is disallowed by the task. Keep history logic in pure exported functions structured for testing.
build_command: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build  (runs on a networked host, NOT in this sandbox)
test_command: none for frontend (no test runner). Verification is by reading/type-consistency and the networked-host build.
verification_instructions: In this INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox, npm install / tsc / vite build CANNOT run (npm registry returns 403). Author everything correct-by-construction: valid TSX/TS/CSS, imports resolve, types line up with frontend/src/api.ts. Verify by reading. The user runs `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build` (and `npm run dev`) on a networked host, then redeploys via Amplify.
setup_instructions: No setup possible in sandbox (no network). On a networked host: `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build`. Optionally prefix with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS` per README note.
environment_constraints: Network mode INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: npm registry 403, so npm install / vite build / tsc CANNOT run in this sandbox. No new dependencies may be added (keep dependencies EXACTLY react + react-dom). Do NOT add a charting library, date library, or react-router. Do NOT generate a lockfile. Do NOT push or open a PR.
contribution_requirements: Preserve ALL existing HomePage behavior (list/quiz/result flow, scoring, answers=-1 for unanswered, score-ring --percent mechanism, aria-labels, Japanese microcopy). History recording must be additive and must not alter scoring or the result display. Do NOT touch backend (lambda/, lib/, test/), API contract, amplify.yml, Cognito/auth, or the admin page core behavior. Match the existing visual system (CSS variables, .card/.btn classes, dark mode via prefers-color-scheme, reduced-motion) and Japanese UI language.
key_patterns: HomePage.tsx uses a `View = 'list' | 'quiz' | 'result'` state machine with useState, rendered via `{view === 'x' && <Component/>}`. Sub-components QuizList/QuizTaking/QuizResult are defined in the same file. On successful submitAnswers the result is set and view switches to 'result'; percent = result.total > 0 ? Math.round((result.score/result.total)*100) : 0. currentQuiz (QuizDetail with title) is in scope at result time. Bottom `.home-link` div links to admin.html. Score-ring uses inline style `{ '--percent': percent } as CSSProperties`. Buttons use .btn / .btn.primary / .btn.small; layout rows use .quiz-actions. Empty states use .empty-state. All UI copy is Japanese. styles.css exposes design tokens as CSS vars: --primary, --primary-dark, --text, --muted, --card, --card-border, --border, --correct, --incorrect, --radius, --radius-sm, --radius-pill, --shadow, --ease, --dur; dark mode overrides them under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark); a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block disables animations globally.

frontend/src/api.ts (reuse types QuizDetail, SubmitResult; DO NOT change)

frontend/src/main.tsx (entry; mounts HomePage in StrictMode - note StrictMode double-invokes effects/render in dev, so record history in the submit callback, NOT in render/effect)
